meanings.en: upright; at right angles to a horizontal plane
meanings.exampleEn: The cliff rose in a sheer vertical wall above the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçurum denizin üstünde dimdik dikey bir duvar gibi yükseliyordu.

meanings.en: sank or fell heavily; dropped suddenly
meanings.exampleEn: Exhausted, he slumped into the armchair and closed his eyes.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitkin bir halde koltuğa çöktü ve gözlerini kapattı.

meanings.en: in a basic and important way
meanings.exampleEn: The two theories are fundamentally different in their approach.
meanings.exampleTr: İki teori yaklaşımları açısından temelde farklıdır.

meanings.en: a large country house with surrounding land
meanings.exampleEn: The old manor had been in the family for centuries.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski malikâne yüzyıllardır ailenin elindeydi.

meanings.en: an estimate that is close but not exact
meanings.exampleEn: This figure is only an approximation of the real cost.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu rakam gerçek maliyetin yalnızca yaklaşık bir değeridir.

meanings.en: estimated or forecast for the future; cast onto a surface
meanings.exampleEn: The projected growth for next year is around five percent.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek yıl için öngörülen büyüme yaklaşık yüzde beştir.

meanings.en: in a never-ending or constant way
meanings.exampleEn: She seemed perpetually busy, always rushing from one task to another.
meanings.exampleTr: O sürekli meşgul görünüyordu, hep bir işten diğerine koşturuyordu.

meanings.en: behaviour that is wrong or wicked
meanings.exampleEn: The novel was condemned for its alleged immorality.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, sözde ahlaksızlığı nedeniyle kınandı.

meanings.en: to leave a place or position so it is empty
meanings.exampleEn: Guests must vacate their rooms by noon.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuklar odalarını öğlene kadar boşaltmalıdır.

meanings.en: morally bad or evil
meanings.exampleEn: The wicked witch cast a spell on the village.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü cadı köyün üzerine bir büyü yaptı.

meanings.en: having or showing high moral standards
meanings.exampleEn: She led a virtuous life devoted to helping others.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkalarına yardım etmeye adanmış erdemli bir hayat sürdü.

meanings.en: the process of developing or moving gradually forward
meanings.exampleEn: The disease's progression can be slowed with early treatment.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın ilerlemesi erken tedaviyle yavaşlatılabilir.

meanings.en: to return to a worse or earlier state
meanings.exampleEn: Without practice, his skills began to regress.
meanings.exampleTr: Pratik yapmayınca becerileri gerilemeye başladı.

meanings.en: the act of describing something as larger or more important than it is
meanings.exampleEn: To call it a disaster would be an overstatement.
meanings.exampleTr: Buna felaket demek bir abartma olur.

meanings.en: a statement that makes something seem less important than it really is
meanings.exampleEn: Saying the storm was 'a bit windy' was a huge understatement.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınaya 'biraz rüzgârlı' demek büyük bir olduğundan az gösterme idi.

meanings.en: to make someone or something seem unimportant
meanings.exampleEn: Don't belittle her achievements; she worked very hard.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun başarılarını küçümseme; çok çalıştı.

meanings.tr: sınava giren kişi, test edilen kişi
meanings.en: a person who is being tested or examined
meanings.exampleEn: Each testee was given an hour to complete the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınava giren her kişiye testi tamamlamak için bir saat verildi.

meanings.en: to fail to reach a required or expected standard
meanings.exampleEn: The results fell short of what we had hoped for.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçlar umduğumuzun gerisinde kaldı.

meanings.en: freedom from a duty, payment, or rule that others must follow
meanings.exampleEn: Students can apply for an exemption from the entrance fee.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler giriş ücretinden muafiyet için başvurabilir.

meanings.en: something that differs from what is normal or expected
meanings.exampleEn: The reading was an anomaly that the scientists could not explain.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölçüm, bilim insanlarının açıklayamadığı bir anormallikti.

meanings.en: a standard or usual pattern of behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: Working from home has become the norm for many companies.
meanings.exampleTr: Evden çalışmak birçok şirket için norm haline geldi.

meanings.en: in most cases; usually
meanings.exampleEn: Ordinarily, I would walk to work, but it was raining today.
meanings.exampleTr: Normalde işe yürürdüm ama bugün yağmur yağıyordu.

meanings.en: not reasonable or within sensible limits; excessive
meanings.exampleEn: His immoderate spending eventually left him in debt.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölçüsüz harcamaları sonunda onu borca soktu.

meanings.en: to shout loudly, often in pain or surprise
meanings.exampleEn: She cried out in pain when she twisted her ankle.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayak bileğini burktuğunda acıyla haykırdı.

meanings.en: to leave out or fail to include something
meanings.exampleEn: You can omit the introduction if you are short of time.
meanings.exampleTr: Vaktin azsa girişi atlayabilirsin.

meanings.en: the act of leaving something out, or the thing left out
meanings.exampleEn: The omission of his name from the list was a mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: İsminin listeden çıkarılması bir hataydı.

meanings.en: except for; unless something happens
meanings.exampleEn: Barring any delays, we should arrive by noon.
meanings.exampleTr: Herhangi bir gecikme olmazsa öğlene kadar varmış oluruz.

meanings.en: the act of including someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The inclusion of all team members in the decision was welcomed.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararda tüm ekip üyelerinin dahil edilmesi memnuniyetle karşılandı.

meanings.en: only; not involving anyone or anything else
meanings.exampleEn: The decision rests solely with the manager.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar yalnızca yöneticiye aittir.

meanings.en: in a way that includes everything or everyone mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: The course runs from Monday to Friday inclusively.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurs pazartesiden cumaya kadar, bu günler dahil olarak sürüyor.

meanings.en: the process of putting a plan or decision into effect
meanings.exampleEn: The implementation of the new policy took several months.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni politikanın uygulanması birkaç ay sürdü.

meanings.en: substances, especially gases, sent out into the air
meanings.exampleEn: The government aims to cut carbon emissions by half.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet karbon emisyonlarını yarıya indirmeyi hedefliyor.

meanings.en: making you feel very tired or weak
meanings.exampleEn: Caring for a newborn can be emotionally draining.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni doğmuş bir bebeğe bakmak duygusal olarak yorucu olabilir.

meanings.en: making you feel fresh, healthy and full of energy
meanings.exampleEn: A cold morning swim is wonderfully invigorating.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk bir sabah yüzmesi harikulade canlandırıcıdır.

meanings.en: physical or mental energy and strength
meanings.exampleEn: She tackled the new project with great vigour.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni projeye büyük bir canlılıkla girişti.

meanings.en: the act of forcing someone to leave a place as a punishment
meanings.exampleEn: His crime led to banishment from the kingdom.
meanings.exampleTr: İşlediği suç, krallıktan sürgün edilmesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: the act of forcing someone to leave an organisation or place
meanings.exampleEn: Repeated cheating led to his expulsion from school.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekrarlanan kopya çekmeler okuldan ihraç edilmesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: the act of sending someone back to their own country
meanings.exampleEn: The repatriation of refugees took place after the war ended.
meanings.exampleTr: Mültecilerin ülkelerine geri gönderilmesi savaş bittikten sonra gerçekleşti.

meanings.en: the act or result of making something bigger
meanings.exampleEn: The enlargement of the harbour allowed bigger ships to dock.
meanings.exampleTr: Limanın genişletilmesi daha büyük gemilerin yanaşmasına olanak sağladı.

meanings.en: the process of becoming smaller or shorter
meanings.exampleEn: The contraction of the muscle causes the joint to bend.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasın kasılması eklemin bükülmesine neden olur.

meanings.en: expected or predicted in advance
meanings.exampleEn: The match drew a larger crowd than anticipated.
meanings.exampleTr: Maç beklenenden daha büyük bir kalabalık çekti.

meanings.en: said in advance that something would happen
meanings.exampleEn: The forecaster predicted heavy rain for the weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Hava tahmincisi hafta sonu için şiddetli yağmur öngördü.

meanings.en: lacking skill or knowledge in a particular area
meanings.exampleEn: His inexpert repairs only made the leak worse.
meanings.exampleTr: Acemi tamirleri sızıntıyı yalnızca daha kötü hale getirdi.

meanings.en: to explode, or cause something to explode
meanings.exampleEn: Engineers detonated the old building with controlled charges.
meanings.exampleTr: Mühendisler eski binayı kontrollü patlayıcılarla patlattı.

meanings.en: to collapse violently inwards
meanings.exampleEn: The vacuum caused the glass tube to implode.
meanings.exampleTr: Vakum cam tüpün içe doğru patlamasına neden oldu.

meanings.en: to make good use of an opportunity, or to exploit someone unfairly
meanings.exampleEn: We should take advantage of the good weather and go hiking.
meanings.exampleTr: Güzel havadan yararlanıp yürüyüşe çıkmalıyız.

meanings.en: a person who enjoys or seeks exciting and risky experiences
meanings.exampleEn: The young adventurer set off to cross the desert alone.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç maceracı çölü tek başına geçmek için yola çıktı.

meanings.en: likely to change suddenly or become dangerous
meanings.exampleEn: The stock market has been extremely volatile this month.
meanings.exampleTr: Borsa bu ay son derece değişken seyretti.

meanings.en: causing strong feelings
meanings.exampleEn: Immigration is a highly emotive subject for many voters.
meanings.exampleTr: Göç, birçok seçmen için son derece duygusal bir konudur.

meanings.en: showing no feeling or emotion
meanings.exampleEn: He listened with an expressionless face, giving nothing away.
meanings.exampleTr: İfadesiz bir yüzle dinledi, hiçbir şey belli etmedi.

meanings.en: the act of making something last longer
meanings.exampleEn: The prolongation of the war caused widespread suffering.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaşın uzatılması yaygın acıya neden oldu.

meanings.en: feeling or showing great joy, especially after a success
meanings.exampleEn: The jubilant fans poured onto the pitch after the win.
meanings.exampleTr: Coşkulu taraftarlar galibiyetin ardından sahaya aktı.

meanings.en: having won a victory or great success
meanings.exampleEn: The team made a triumphant return home with the trophy.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım kupayla birlikte muzaffer bir şekilde evine döndü.

meanings.en: sad and disappointed
meanings.exampleEn: He looked dejected after failing the driving test again.
meanings.exampleTr: Ehliyet sınavında yine kaldıktan sonra üzgün görünüyordu.

meanings.en: in low spirits from loss of hope or courage
meanings.exampleEn: After months of job-hunting, she grew despondent.
meanings.exampleTr: Aylarca süren iş aramanın ardından umutsuzluğa kapıldı.

meanings.en: the forehead, or the area of skin above the eyes
meanings.exampleEn: She wiped the sweat from her brow after the run.
meanings.exampleTr: Koşunun ardından alnındaki teri sildi.

meanings.en: one of the small hairs growing on the edge of the eyelid; a stroke with a whip
meanings.exampleEn: Her long dark lashes framed her bright eyes.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun koyu kirpikleri parlak gözlerini çerçeveliyordu.

meanings.en: any type of cloth or woven fabric
meanings.exampleEn: The region is famous for its colourful handmade textiles.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölge renkli el yapımı tekstilleriyle ünlüdür.

meanings.en: extremely good or wonderful
meanings.exampleEn: We had a marvellous time at the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Festivalde harika vakit geçirdik.

meanings.en: useful or pleasant features and facilities of a place
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel offers excellent amenities, including a pool and gym.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel havuz ve spor salonu dahil mükemmel olanaklar sunuyor.

meanings.en: supplies of money, materials, or other assets that can be used
meanings.exampleEn: The country is rich in natural resources such as oil and gas.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke petrol ve gaz gibi doğal kaynaklar bakımından zengindir.

meanings.en: the state of being widely known and admired
meanings.exampleEn: The chef gained international renown for her inventive dishes.
meanings.exampleTr: Şef yaratıcı yemekleriyle uluslararası ün kazandı.

meanings.en: the state of being unknown or forgotten
meanings.exampleEn: The once-famous singer faded into obscurity.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir zamanlar ünlü olan şarkıcı unutulmuşluğa gömüldü.

meanings.en: to make someone familiar with something
meanings.exampleEn: Please take time to acquaint yourself with the safety rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen güvenlik kurallarını öğrenmek için zaman ayırın.

meanings.en: strongly attracted and held the attention of someone
meanings.exampleEn: The audience was captivated by her powerful performance.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyirci onun güçlü performansıyla büyülendi.

meanings.en: made very curious or interested
meanings.exampleEn: I was intrigued by the mysterious letter on my desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Masamdaki gizemli mektup merakımı uyandırdı.

meanings.en: the state of being fascinated or charmed
meanings.exampleEn: There was a look of pure captivation on the child's face.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuğun yüzünde saf bir büyülenme ifadesi vardı.

meanings.en: having a fault or not working correctly
meanings.exampleEn: The shop replaced the defective phone free of charge.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza arızalı telefonu ücretsiz değiştirdi.

meanings.en: a thin wire or thread, especially the one in a light bulb
meanings.exampleEn: When the filament burns out, the bulb stops working.
meanings.exampleTr: Flaman yandığında ampul çalışmayı durdurur.

meanings.en: created or designed something that did not exist before
meanings.exampleEn: Edison invented many devices, including the phonograph.
meanings.exampleTr: Edison fonograf da dahil olmak üzere birçok cihaz icat etti.
